services.name: G7 Presents: Stand-up Comedy Night
services.desc: Join veteran comedian, Cliff Prang, and host of highly talented comics for a night of stand-up comedy. Featuring emerging and established comics from around the region, this performance promises to be a fun-filled night the whole family can enjoy! For fastest service, consider booking your tickets online. For phone orders, please give extra time for us to process due to limited staff resources. Tickets cannot be purchased in person at the G7 office. Gallery 7 Theatre is made possible by the generous support of our sponsors and community partners. P.O. Box 825 Abbotsford, B.C.
